doc.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997

title: Berklee scholarship and Herb Pomeroy's ensembles
summary: He won a Berklee scholarship, stayed a year, soloed in ensembles while a reader sat beside him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: You went on to Berklee, right?

I won the first scholarship offer there. I stayed there a year. Same thing — couldn’t read but I was in all the ensembles. In fact Herb Pomeroy actually had another baritone player sit there and read the parts and I took all of the solos. But I would look over his shoulder and watch him read and that helped me to learn how to read too.
